page.layout: One block of text, centred and justified on a single printed page. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top right. Below the text, a centred word "FINIS". No margin notes. Faint show-through from the reverse side fills the lower half and is left out.

main_text.p: cunque[?] folueris super terram, erit solutum & in cœlis, & quodcunq; ligaueris super terram, &c. Super terram inquit, nam in ligatione de-functum, nunquam dixit absoluendum.
Sunt hæc validissima contra indulgentias Pontificias, & Purgatorij figmentum.

page.notes: The first word of the page is partly cut off at the left edge; the initial letter is read as c with [?]. The page number is set in an old-style figure and is read as 82. The faint printed text in the lower half is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed.
